title: This is a nice storage container
text: This is a nice storage container. This is a nice storage container.  The sides don't collapse which is a good thing.  The container is attractive.  It only gets 4 stars because it's way too expensive for what it is.  I would say this would be a good value if it cost less than $15.00.  $12 at the most would be my buy price.
